subject: BrightWorks customer spotlight - collateral & logo usage clearance
body:
From: Alice Jordan <alice@brightworks.io>
To: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: customer spotlight collateral + logo use

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the great briefing last week. BrightWorks would love to be featured in a short customer spotlight on your site and in a one-page case study we plan to include in the upcoming product launch kit.

We would like to use a short quote from Marcus (attached draft below) along with our company logo and a product screenshot. Please let us know what you need from us for approvals (logo files, guidance on attribution, any legal forms).

Attached: BrightWorks_Logo_RGB.png, draft_quote.docx

Best,
Alice
Alice Jordan
Head of Corporate Communications
BrightWorks Inc.

-----
From: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:03:12 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: customer spotlight collateral + logo use (BrightWorks)

Team — forwarding BrightWorks' request. They shipped the logo files and a short quote; they want a web spotlight + one-pager.

Quick asks:
- Can we use the attached logo (BrightWorks_Logo_RGB.png) as-is? Any trademark requirements? (Laura)
- Rishi, confirm Marcus is ok to be quoted as-is and whether we should shorten the quote for the hero banner. Also confirm this is fine for public marketing under DEAL-2391.

Attachments: brightworks_brand_guidelines.pdf

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0179

-----
From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:27:43 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: customer spotlight collateral + logo use (BrightWorks)

Thanks Olga — quick note from the account side. Marcus confirmed verbally on Friday that BrightWorks is happy to be a reference and to provide a short quote. He prefers the following wording for the one-pager: "Redwood Inference reduced our inference cost per token by 38% while improving median latency by 40% across peak workloads."

Can we trim that to a shorter hero line for the site, e.g. "38% lower cost and 40% faster inference at peak" ? For the one-pager, we can keep the full sentence. Marcus is ok with public attribution to BrightWorks Inc. and to reference their work with us on the DEAL-2391 pilot.

I uploaded a screenshot and the signed MMPA draft to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3ExampleDriveLink

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com

-----
From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:05:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: customer spotlight collateral + logo use (BrightWorks)

Hi all — reviewed their brand guidelines and the logo file. A few legal points before we publish: 

1) We need explicit written permission for the final quote and logo usage. The email thread from Alice plus Marcus' confirmation should be fine, but I recommend a short signature form: one para confirming permission to use (logo + quote + screenshot) and confirming trademark attribution. I can draft this and send to Alice for signature (DocuSign).
2) Please ask BrightWorks to confirm the precise trademark string to appear under the logo (e.g., "BrightWorks®" or "BrightWorks™").
3) Minor redline on our MMPA: their draft includes a broad publicity clause. I've attached a redline (redline_mmpa_v2.pdf). We should ask for the publicity clause to remain mutual (both parties can use the other's name/logo for marketing). If not, we need written permission scoped to this one-pager + web spotlight.

If marketing needs final assets, let me know and I will bundle the short permission language into a DocuSign envelope.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

-----
From: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@brightworks.io>
To: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com, Alice Jordan <alice@brightworks.io>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:15:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: customer spotlight collateral + logo use

Olga / team,

Thanks — we can sign the short permission clause Laura suggested. Trademark string is "BrightWorks®". I reviewed the one-pager quote and the shorter hero line looks good to us. You have permission to use the following quote for the one-pager: "Redwood reduced our inference costs by 38% while improving median latency by 40%." Please use BrightWorks® under the logo.

I've asked our legal to sign the DocuSign — you should see the envelope at: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/DS-EXAMPLE-2391

Regards,
Marcus Hale
VP, Product & Engineering
BrightWorks Inc.
marcus.hale@brightworks.io

-----
From: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
To: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@brightworks.io>, Alice Jordan <alice@brightworks.io>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: customer spotlight collateral + logo use

Perfect — thanks Marcus and Alice. Laura, Rishi: I will send the DocuSign package with the short permission clause and the final assets (BrightWorks_Logo_RGB.png, hero_quote.txt, screenshot_highres.png). Once the envelope is signed I’ll schedule the spotlight to go live in the next sprint.

Olga Petrov
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: BrightWorks_Logo_RGB.png, brightworks_brand_guidelines.pdf, redline_mmpa_v2.pdf
